name: Sharwa Finance leveraged-position close under manipulated swap prices
summary: The recorded transaction supplied 40,000 USDC to LiquidityPool 0x02434cd23972c82fbabf610d157b41bfb45a45a3, supplied 2,200 USDC margin, opened a 0.362 WBTC long through TradeRouter 0xd3fde5af30da1f394d6e0d361b552648d0dff797, and withdrew the LP shares. A later transaction manipulated the WBTC/USDC pool while closing that position. Complete root-cause attribution and the earliest successful exercise remain unresolved.

loss.notes: Imported from the seed inventory, which did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

ageReset.description: Unreviewed TradeRouter deployment; this entry point is not the liquidity pool and has not been established as the defect-bearing artifact.

limitations: TradeRouter is a direct entry point; the defect-bearing swap/pricing and position-accounting artifacts and latest causal configuration reset remain unresolved.
Deployment transaction, runtime hash and complete history remain unresolved.

sources.note: Superseded by source-5: the seed mislabeled TradeRouter as the liquidity pool and confused raw token quantities with decimal units. Its deployment timestamp is not an established defect age.

Partial review, not promotion. Reproduce with eth_getTransactionReceipt and debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) for source-1 and source-6 on Arbitrum. Source-1 Transfer logs 4/6/11/14/18/45/48 show attacker input 2,201 USDC, flash loan/deposit 40,000 USDC, margin 2,200 USDC, pool borrow 39,953.190410 USDC, LP withdrawal 39,999.999999 USDC and loan repayment 40,000 USDC (USDC has 6 decimals). WBTC logs 28/31/33 carry 36,200,000 base units = 0.362 WBTC. Source-6 logs 17/18 return 2,075.724303 USDC to that pool and pay 0.000001 USDC insurance; log 28 sends 0.30750293 WBTC to the attacker. These are one leg, not a valuation of the entire reported campaign. Verified Etherscan V2 getsourcecode for source-7 identifies TradeRouter and for source-8 LiquidityPool; TradeRouter forwards to facade 0xb84945ec1c4e9973cb108a6ba76fa6d46856e679 in source-1 trace. Pool getTotalLiquidity includes debt by design; the observed LP withdrawal alone does not establish double-counting. Unresolved: exact defective pricing/accounting artifacts, whether source-1 is the first successful exercise, and complete campaign depletion excluding supplied collateral. Next: trace the earlier/later transactions named in source-2 (0xb0bf77475818b2501e78f0927f4131e52c6efd45bc4978992cbbe218a57e6f7f and 0x35a523bdaf60a9e8b66ab92bb8b78d5012e102e462b665e98ce46f7e07addd36), scan both reported senders, and inspect verified facade/swap-adapter code and setter history before selecting targets or an age reset.

limitations: Earliest successful exercise, defect-bearing artifacts and complete campaign remain unresolved; source-5 records reproduction coordinates and next investigation.
The reported $146,000 is not reproduced as structured onchain victim depletion; the two traced transactions cover only one leg.
